section.heading: Creation of the Northeast Heights TIF Area.

para.text: There is created a TIF area designated as the Northeast Heights TIF Area, which shall consist of Square 5051N, Lot 19; Square 5051, Lots 28, 29, 811; and Square 5044, Lot 814, as shown on the tax rolls of the District as maintained by the Office of Tax and Revenue.

As provided in § 2-1217.40bb, the Available Tax Increment from the Northeast Heights TIF Area shall be deposited in the Northeast Heights TIF Fund and may be used for the purposes set forth in § 2-1217.40bb.
The base year for determination of Available Sales Tax Revenues from locations within the Northeast Heights TIF Area shall be the tax year preceding the year in which this subpart becomes effective.

The base year for determination of Available Real Property Tax Revenues from properties within the Northeast Heights TIF Area shall be the tax year preceding the year in which this subpart becomes effective, and the initial assessed value to be used in making the determination of Available Real Property Tax Revenues shall be the assessed value of each lot of taxable real property in the Northeast Heights TIF Area for the tax year preceding the tax year in which this subpart becomes effective.
The Northeast Heights TIF Area shall terminate on the earliest of:
The date on which the Bonds are paid in full or are defeased and are no longer outstanding; or
Five years after [August 13, 2026] if no Bonds are issued.
